title: tethik-frieren
description: Private mod with no overarching goal, just a collection of minor features
body:
A collection of items, gameplay changes, quality of life fixes with no overarching goal in mind. Just my own personal modifications that could one day belong in their own dedicated mod.

So far it adds:

## Items
* Endless buckets of Lava|Water|Nothing
* A friend-teleport ring

## QoL
* Recipes to make cobblestone into gravel into sand
* Easier lodestone recipe
* Recipe for ability bottles from everlasting abilities.
* No Silk touch requirement for glass

## Gameplay
* Overworld regions now have a "mana" value. This is used to determine if mobs can spawn on blocks under the sky. Each killed mob reduces the mana in the region, meaning you can make an area relatively safe from mobs by clearing enough of them.
